Listados.metodologiaTexto: We start from a real search for places with specific reputation for this (not just general popularity): that reputation decides what makes the list. The final order, however, is decided by the average rating and number of real Google Maps reviews, not reputation — and only places with a minimum rating of {ratingMinimo} and at least {resenasMinimas} reviews make the list.
Listados.metodologiaTextoSinRating: We start from a real search for places with genuine reputation and recognition for this, and rank them by that. In this category, the number of Google Maps reviews isn't a reliable quality signal, so we don't apply a minimum rating — Google Maps is only used to confirm each place really exists, plus its address and photos.
